title: ::: K-IG 교육 영어듣기훈련프로그램 | 기초2 | 제 001 회 강의 :::
label: [ Lesson 42 ]

items.text: Lend this money to whomever you trust.
It is he who is to blame.
alternatives: It is he who should be blamed.
It is he that is to blame.
It is he who is to be blamed.

items.text: I don't care what you think.
alternatives: I don't mind what you think.

items.text: May I ask what this is about?
alternatives: Can I ask what this is about?
Could I ask what this is about?

items.text: Could you tell me what the regular fare is between Los Angeles and New York?
alternatives: Can you tell me what the regular fare is between Los Angeles and New York?
Could you tell me what the regular fare between Los Angeles and New York is?
Could you tell me how much the regular fare is between Los Angeles and New York?

items.text: Whose finger was on the button almost defined electoral success.
alternatives: Whose finger was on the button almost determined electoral success.
Whose finger was on the button nearly defined electoral success.
Whose finger was on the button almost defined election victory.
Whose finger was on the button almost decided electoral success.

items.text: Compare what you have done with what you have seen.
alternatives: Compare what you did with what you saw.
Compare what you have done to what you have seen.

items.text: Why this is a problem was dramatically illustrated when the keynote speaker was ousted for having been a marijuana user.
alternatives: Why this is a problem was dramatically revealed when the keynote speaker was ousted for having been a marijuana user.
Why this is a problem was dramatically shown when the keynote speaker was ousted for having been a marijuana user.
Why this is a problem was dramatically illustrated when the keynote speaker was kicked out for having been a marijuana user.
Why this is a problem was dramatically illustrated when the keynote speaker was ousted because he had been a marijuana user.
Why this is a problem was illustrated dramatically when the keynote speaker was ousted for having been a marijuana user.

items.text: The question is who will get there first.
alternatives: The question is who will arrive there first.
The problem is who will get there first.
The question is who is going to get there first.

items.text: It is a mystery to me how they can live together when they no longer love each other.
alternatives: It is a mystery to me how they can live together when they don't love each other anymore.
How they can live together when they no longer love each other is a mystery to me.

items.text: There are various problems the solution of which is hopeless.
alternatives: There are various problems of which the solution is hopeless.

items.text: Is this the man of whom you spoke yesterday?
alternatives: Is this the man about whom you spoke yesterday?
Is this the man about whom you talked yesterday?
Is this the person of whom you spoke yesterday?
